sentences.zh: 直到现在我成了一个面临着和剧中角色同样问题的成年人，而且未来也将继续如此。

sentences.en: So, Himyam will stay and be friends with me a bit longer.
sentences.zh: 所以，《老爸老妈浪漫史》还会继续陪伴我更长的时间。

sentences.en: Thank you for everything, for creating this magic.
sentences.zh: 感谢这一切，感谢你们创造了这魔法般的作品。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太美妙了。

sentences.en: At Frederick Bale, 7403, I hope I'm saying that right, says,
sentences.zh: Frederick Bale 7403——希望我没读错——说，

sentences.en: Whoa, do I believe in destiny?
sentences.zh: 哇，我相信命运吗？

sentences.en: Well, as it happens, I just finished re-watching the whole show for like the 30th time last week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，碰巧的是，我上周刚完成了大概第30遍的全剧重温。

sentences.en: Talked about it yesterday evening with a friend, planned on talking about it today as part of a segment on a local radio show.
sentences.zh: 昨晚刚和朋友聊过，还计划今天在当地一档电台节目的环节里聊这个。

sentences.en: Finally this morning, having a suggestion from YouTube for a podcast and finding out of nowhere that you guys were doing,
sentences.zh: 结果今天早上，YouTube推送了一个播客，莫名其妙地发现你们正在做这个，

sentences.en: We're going to do this thing and revisit the whole show.
sentences.zh: 我们要来做这件事并重温整部剧了。

sentences.en: So, yes, if I didn't believe in destiny, now I do.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，如果我以前不相信命运，现在我相信了。

sentences.en: Thanks for this amazing gift that you're bringing us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你给我们带来这份惊艳的礼物。

sentences.en: Love the show so much since the very first watch back in 05.
sentences.zh: 从2005年最初观看起，我就一直超级喜欢这部剧。

sentences.en: That is, that's my kind of destiny right there.
sentences.zh: 那就是，那才是我所理解的命运。

sentences.en: I love that he's having a Mosby-ish destiny moment, but it's about discovering our podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴他经历了一个莫斯比式的命运时刻，但这是关于发现我们的播客。

sentences.en: Hearing us talk about Ted Mosby.
sentences.zh: 听我们谈论泰德·莫斯比。

sentences.en: From Virai6500, hello and love from China.
sentences.zh: 来自Virai6500，你好，来自中国的爱。

sentences.en: Last weekend, my high school friends and I were talking about how this show became our comfort TV series
sentences.zh: 上周末，我和高中朋友们在讨论这部剧是如何成为我们的治愈系电视剧的

sentences.en: and how we both re-watched him more than dozens of times in the past 10 years.
sentences.zh: 以及在过去的10年里，我们俩是怎么重温了它几十遍的。

sentences.en: You have accompanied us for our whole adolescence and so much love to you guys.
sentences.zh: 你们陪伴了我们的整个青春期，向你们致以满满的爱。

sentences.en: Just kind of overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 有点不知所措。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: The number of viewings we hear about from some people, and I just, I take them all, I'm just going to assume that's true.
sentences.zh: 我们听说有些人观看的次数惊人，我，我全都接受，我姑且就认为那是真的吧。

sentences.en: We've heard of 30s, we've heard of 40s.
sentences.zh: 我们听说过30多遍的，听说过40多遍的。

sentences.en: Alec, didn't we hear one that was 100 some odd times?
sentences.zh: 亚历克，我们不是听说过有一个看了100多次的吗？

sentences.en: We broke a hundred yesterday.
sentences.zh: 我们昨天打破了一百次。

sentences.en: Yes, we did.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们做到了。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Tell if we believed that, if that was you, write back to us to reaffirm, reconfirm that number.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们如果我们相信了那是真的，如果那个人是你，请回信给我们重新证实、确认那个数字。

sentences.en: But it's amazing.
sentences.zh: 但这太惊人了。

sentences.en: Thanks, everybody.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: That's just amazing.
sentences.zh: 这简直太棒了。

sentences.en: And hello from China.
sentences.zh: 还有来自中国的问候。

sentences.en: I love China.
sentences.zh: 我爱中国。

sentences.en: Vietnam, we're hearing all over the world.
sentences.zh: 越南，我们听到世界各地都有人在听。

sentences.en: So cool.
sentences.zh: 太酷了。

sentences.en: And finally, sorry, from Edwin Laubrely6035, I just want you guys to know that your show meant a lot to me.
sentences.zh: 最后，抱歉，来自Edwin Laubrely6035，我只是想让你们知道，你们的节目对我很重要。

sentences.en: I do not watch podcasts.
sentences.zh: 我不看播客。

sentences.en: I'm not into the podcast, but this is the podcast I'm going to watch and listen to.
sentences.zh: 我对播客不感兴趣，但这是我会观看和收听的播客。

sentences.en: I'm now watching, but I needed to leave a comment firSt.
sentences.zh: 我现在正在看，但我得先留个言。

sentences.en: I'm going through a whole lot in my life, things that are just very hard.
sentences.zh: 我的生活正经历很多事情，有些事情非常艰难。

sentences.en: And the first thing I did today when dealing with a lot of stress was put on an episode of How I Met Your Mother.
sentences.zh: 而今天面对巨大压力时，我做的第一件事就是播放一集《老爸老妈浪漫史》。

sentences.en: Because even when I'm dealing with things that make me want to do nothing but crawl up in a ball and cry, I can put on this show,
sentences.zh: 因为即使当我面对那些让我只想缩成一团哭泣的事情时，我也可以播放这部剧，

sentences.en: and it can bring a smile to my face when it's very hard for anything else, too.
sentences.zh: 当其他任何事都很难做到时，它也能让我的脸上露出微笑。

sentences.en: I just wanted you guys to know you made a great show, and this will be the first podcast I'll ever pay attention to in my life.
sentences.zh: 我只是想让你们知道你们制作了一部伟大的剧集，这将是我一生中关注的第一个播客。

sentences.en: Take that smartness.
sentences.zh: 领教一下这机智吧。

sentences.en: Thank you guys very much for doing this and making a great show that even in the darkest days can still bring out a little smile and nothing else can.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们做这些并制作了一部伟大的剧集，即使在最黑暗的日子里，它依然能带出一丝微笑，而其他任何东西都做不到。

sentences.en: How nice is that to hear, Josh?
sentences.zh: 听起来多好啊，乔什？

sentences.en: And boy, he really has no interest in podcasts.
sentences.zh: 天哪，他对播客是真的毫无兴趣。

sentences.en: No, just driving three towns over to shit on podcasts for no reason.
sentences.zh: 不，只是开车去三个镇以外，无缘无故地贬低播客。

sentences.en: But it's almost like How I Met Your Mother is a good sitcom for people who don't like sitcoMs.
sentences.zh: 但这几乎就像是《老爸老妈浪漫史》是一部适合那些不喜欢情景喜剧的人的情景喜剧。

sentences.en: Oh, well said.
sentences.zh: 哦，说得好。

sentences.en: Oh, boy.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: Well said.
sentences.zh: 说得好。

sentences.en: Hit stop there, Alec.
sentences.zh: 就停在那儿吧，亚历克。

sentences.en: It's not getting any better than that.
sentences.zh: 不会再有比这更好的了。

sentences.en: Mic drop.
sentences.zh: 扔麦。

sentences.en: Boom.
sentences.zh: 轰。

sentences.en: I am guilty.
sentences.zh: 我有罪。

sentences.en: Please acquit me.
sentences.zh: 请宣判我无罪。

sentences.en: All sins are forgiven.
sentences.zh: 一切罪孽皆可宽恕。
